items.title: EIP-8037：账户创建在访问时按条件收费
items.note: （chfast）提交：CREATE/CREATE2 不再先无条件收费再退还，而是在同时执行 EIP-7610 冲突检查的那一次目标地址访问时按条件收取；未通过余额、nonce 或深度检查的创建不会读取目标地址，也不收费；预先注资的确定性部署地址等已存在的目标不收费。
items.title_en: EIP-8037: charge account creation conditionally at access
items.note_en: (chfast), submitted: instead of charging unconditionally and refilling, CREATE/CREATE2 charge at the single destination access that also performs the EIP-7610 collision check; creations failing the balance, nonce or depth checks never read the destination and charge nothing, and pre-existing destinations such as pre-funded deterministic deployment addresses charge nothing.

items.title: EIP-7997：加入类似 EAS 的字节码，把工厂合约视为系统合约
items.note: （jochem-brouwer）提交，与 EIP-7002、EIP-7251 的系统合约做法一致。
items.title_en: EIP-7997: add EAS-like bytecode, treating the factory contract as a system contract
items.note_en: (jochem-brouwer), submitted, matching the system contract approach of EIP-7002 and EIP-7251.

items.title: 新 EIP：Builder Execution Requests
items.note: （wemeetagain）合并，即 EIP-8282：为 EIP-7732（ePBS）的 builder 在 EIP-7685 请求总线上提供独立的执行层请求合约，而不是借用验证者流程处理 builder 加入与退出；EIP-8282：与 gloas 规范同步 提交，前缀改为 `0xB0` 并加入余额检查。
items.note_en: (wemeetagain), merged as EIP-8282: it gives EIP-7732 (ePBS) builders their own execution layer request contracts on the EIP-7685 request bus instead of routing builder onboarding and exit through validator flows; EIP-8282: sync with the gloas spec, submitted, changing the prefix to `0xB0` and adding a balance check.

items.title: EIP-8282：与 gloas 规范同步
items.note: 新 EIP：Builder Execution Requests（wemeetagain）合并，即 EIP-8282：为 EIP-7732（ePBS）的 builder 在 EIP-7685 请求总线上提供独立的执行层请求合约，而不是借用验证者流程处理 builder 加入与退出；EIP-8282：与 gloas 规范同步 提交，前缀改为 `0xB0` 并加入余额检查。
items.title_en: EIP-8282: sync with the gloas spec
items.note_en: New EIP: Builder Execution Requests (wemeetagain), merged as EIP-8282: it gives EIP-7732 (ePBS) builders their own execution layer request contracts on the EIP-7685 request bus instead of routing builder onboarding and exit through validator flows; EIP-8282: sync with the gloas spec, submitted, changing the prefix to `0xB0` and adding a balance check.

items.title: 新 EIP：多区块访问列表预热
items.note: （nerolation）合并，即 EIP-8289：用 256 个区块的滚动预热集合（以 SHA-256 SMT 根提交到区块头）让 EIP-2929 访问列表跨区块延续，每区块 gas 中位数节省约 14%，节点额外状态约 10 MB。
items.title_en: New EIP: Multi-block Access List Warming
items.note_en: (nerolation), merged as EIP-8289: a 256-block rolling warm access multiset, committed via a SHA-256 SMT root in the block header, carries the EIP-2929 access list across blocks, for about a 14% median gas saving per block at about 10 MB of node state.

keywords_en: Starknet STRK20 protocol level privacy pool goes live
EIP-8037 conditional charge for contract creation
EIP-8289 multi-block access list warming merged
summary_en: StarkWare announced that STRK20 is fully live on mainnet, a privacy pool integrated at the protocol level that brings native privacy to all assets. awrichardson submitted the ERC-8322 Notary-Backed Confidential Token PR. chfast submitted an EIP-8037 change so that CREATE/CREATE2 charge account creation conditionally, only at the actual destination access. EIP-8282 builder execution requests and EIP-8289 multi-block access list warming were merged. Ethereal news #30 was published.
